name: Instapaper
description: Saved bookmarks, folders, reading progress, stars, archive state, tags, and highlights through Instapaper's published Full API.
agentUseSummary: Enter Instapaper credentials once for the provider-required xAuth exchange; Railway immediately discards the password and retains only the OAuth token bundle for selected Safe or Dangerous agent tools.

credentialRequirements.name: INSTAPAPER_PASSWORD
credentialRequirements.label: Password, if the account has one

capabilities.label: Library reads
capabilities.description: Read the connected account, folders, bounded bookmarks, and highlights.

capabilities.label: Full Instapaper API
capabilities.description: Add, update, move, archive, star, delete, organize, and highlight through every published Full API operation.

allowed.label: List bookmarks
allowed.description: List a bounded page of saved bookmarks.

approvalRequired.label: Use full Instapaper API
approvalRequired.description: Use any published Full API operation; Safe mode requires approval.

blocked.label: Persist password
blocked.description: Instapaper passwords are used only for xAuth and must be discarded immediately.

blocked.label: Unrequested automated additions
blocked.description: Provider terms require each saved item to originate from an explicit user selection.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded reads run directly; mutations and raw Full API operations require approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Every selected OAuth-authorized operation runs without Relay per-action approval; ownership, fixed origin, provider terms, bounds, and audits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts selected tools and signs OAuth 1.0a requests server-side.
Railway mounts selected tools and signs OAuth 1.0a requests server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay must sign into Instapaper, register and submit the application for human approval, then configure the consumer key and secret on Railway.
providerSetup.nextAction: Create the Relay Console app in Instapaper Applications, request activation, configure INSTAPAPER_CONSUMER_KEY and INSTAPAPER_CONSUMER_SECRET on Railway, then run xAuth, health, a bounded read, and an approved or Dangerous-mode mutation. No callback URL is used by xAuth.

evidence.supports: Instapaper requires OAuth 1.0a HMAC-SHA1 and xAuth, starts new applications in Owner Only mode, and requires human approval before activation.
The Full API lists, adds, updates, moves, archives, stars, deletes, and fetches saved bookmarks with bounded list limits.
The Full API lists, creates, deletes, and reorders folders.
The Full API lists, creates, and deletes highlights; non-subscribers have a monthly highlight limit.
Passwords may only be collected for xAuth and must be discarded immediately; destructive changes require explicit user action and published API methods must be used.
